name: Clockwork Tide Mill
description: A grand brass-and-wood tide mill built into sea cliffs, with gears turned by waves and glowing jellyfish.
prompt: A single majestic image of a fantastical clockwork tide mill built into glowing sea cliffs. Giant brass gears and wooden waterwheels are turned by crashing turquoise waves, while luminous jellyfish drift through the machinery. Warm lamplight glows from round windows, mist and sea spray fill the air. Steampunk-meets-ocean atmosphere, intricate detail, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: The ocean is the clockmaker here. Listen—every wave turns another gear.
